tools.name: CreateAccount
tools.description: Create a new user account with personal information and sign-in information.

tools.name: GetBestsellers
tools.description: Get the top-selling products from the store.

tools.name: GetCart
tools.description: Get current cart contents.

tools.name: GetCustomerAttributes
tools.description: Get extended customer attributes including custom fields.

tools.name: GetCustomerInfo
tools.description: Get current customer profile information.

tools.name: GetOrderHistory
tools.description: Get detailed order history with items and status.

tools.name: GetRecentViewed
tools.description: Get recently viewed products.

tools.name: GetStoreInfo
tools.description: Get store configuration including currency, locale, and store name.

tools.name: GetSupportInfo
tools.description: Get customer support contact information including email, phone, and hours.

tools.name: GetWishlist
tools.description: Get wishlist items.

tools.name: GoToCheckout
tools.description: Go to/Navigate to the checkout page.

tools.name: NavigateToCartPage
tools.description: Navigate to the shopping cart page.

tools.name: NavigateToCategory
tools.description: Navigate to a category page (PLP) by name (case-insensitive, partial match). Omit the argument to list all available categories. Provide a category name to navigate to it (searches across all menu levels).

category.description: Category name to navigate to (e.g. "Professional", "Styling Tools") (case-insensitive, partial match).

tools.name: NavigateToHomePage
tools.description: Navigate to the store homepage to view current promotions, campaigns, and featured collections. This tool can also b used to reset the browsing session or start a new shopping journey.

tools.name: RemoveFromCart
tools.description: Remove a specific item from the cart using product SKU. If SKU is not known, first use GetCart to get the current cart items with their SKUs, then call this tool with the exact SKU.

sku.description: Product SKU for exact matching. Get SKU from GetCart tool.

tools.name: SearchProducts
tools.description: Search for products in the catalog by keyword or product name. Use this when the user explicitly asks to search, or when a product the user wants to add to cart is not visible on the current page. Do NOT use this if the product is already visible on the current listing page — use AddProductToCartPLP instead.

q.description: The keyword or product name to search for in the catalog.

tools.name: SignIn
tools.description: Sign in to user account with your email address and password.

tools.name: SignInAtCheckout
tools.description: Sign in to your account during checkout using your email address and password.

tools.name: SubscribeToNewsletter
tools.description: Subscribe to the newsletter with your email address.

tools.name: UpdateCartItemQty
tools.description: Update the quantity of a specific item in the cart using product SKU. If SKU is not known, first use GetCart to get the current cart items with their SKUs, then call this tool with the exact SKU and new quantity. To remove an item entirely use RemoveFromCart instead.

sku.description: Product SKU for exact matching. Get SKU from GetCart or GetProductDetails tool.

quantity.description: The new desired quantity. Must be 1 or more.

tools.name: ViewCart
tools.description: Show the user their cart in the cart drawer and get cart details.
